# ------------------------------------------------- extra edge coverage cases
def case_lease_isolation():
    """Evidence never joins across leases, even for overlapping prefixes."""
    rows = [row('icmp', 'a', 0, 5, 'put', 'L', 1, '0/i1', a(1), a(1), 'echo'),
            row('icmp', 'b', 0, 5, 'put', 'M', 1, '0/i1', a(1), a(7), 'echo'),
            row('app', 'x', 0, 5, 'put', 'M', 6, '', a(1), '', 'open', 'S', 0)]
    out = run(job(leases=[lease(), lease(lid='M')], services=[{'id': 'S', 'kind': 'tcp'}],
                 captures=capture(rows)), 'isolation')
    first = lease_entry(out, 0, 'L')
    second = lease_entry(out, 0, 'M')
    check('lease L keeps its own internal', first['internal'] == [a(1)], first)
    check('lease M does not borrow L evidence', second['internal'] == [] and
          second['external'] == [a(7)], second)
    check('lease M app is unbound', out['snapshots'][0]['unbound_applications'] == 1,
          out['snapshots'][0])
    check('overlap repeats manifest rows',
          [x['lease'] for x in out['manifest']] == ['L'] * 3 + ['M'] * 3, out['manifest'])
    check('lease L open via its own evidence',
          service_entry(first, 'S')['internal_open'] == [], first)


def case_canary_and_probe_errors():
    rows = [row('icmp', 'k', 0, 5, 'put', 'L', 1, '0/c', cw(), cw(), 'error'),
            row('icmp', 'cross', 0, 5, 'put', 'L', 1, '0/i1', a(1), a(1), 'echo')]
    out = run(job(leases=[lease(), lease(lid='M')], captures=capture(rows)), 'canary-error')
    entry = lease_entry(out)
    check('canary self error is not alias', entry['state'] == 'usable' and
          entry['internal'] == [a(1)], entry)
    # a probe planned in another lease is not valid here
    rows = [row('icmp', 'x', 0, 5, 'put', 'L', 1, '0/i3', a(3), a(3), 'echo')]
    out = run(job(leases=[lease(), lease(lid='M', lows=4)], captures=capture(rows)),
              'cross-probe')
    check('probe from another lease rejected', out['rejected'] == [[0, 0]], out['rejected'])
    # oversized integers and out-of-range times are record failures
    for revision, published, event, label in [
            ('1000000001', 5, 1, 'revision above 1e9'),
            ('0', '10000000000001', 1, 'published above 1e12'),
            ('0', 5, '1000000000001', 'event above 1e12'),
            ('000000000000000000', 5, 1, 'too many digits'),
            ('0x10', 5, 1, 'hex digits'),
            ('-1', 5, 1, 'negative')]:
        rows = [row('icmp', 'x', revision, published, 'put', 'L', event, '0/i1', a(1),
                    a(1), 'echo')]
        out = run(job(leases=[lease()], captures=capture(rows)), label)
        check('record failure: %s' % label, out['rejected'] == [[0, 0]], out['rejected'])


def case_duplicate_identities_and_withdrawal():
    """Two live rows can support one address; deleting both removes it."""
    rows = [row('icmp', 'p1', 0, 5, 'put', 'L', 4, '0/i1', a(1), a(1), 'echo'),
            row('icmp', 'p2', 0, 5, 'put', 'L', 7, '0/i1', a(1), a(1), 'echo'),
            row('app', 'q1', 0, 9, 'put', 'L', 5, '', a(1), '', 'open', 'T', 1),
            row('app', 'q2', 0, 9, 'put', 'L', 5, '', a(1), '', 'open', 'T', 1)]
    out = run(job(leases=[lease()], services=[{'id': 'T', 'kind': 'tcp'}],
                 captures=capture(rows)), 'duplicate-support')
    entry = lease_entry(out)
    check('earliest witness supports both rows',
          service_entry(entry, 'T')['internal_open'] == [a(1)], entry)
    rows.append(row('icmp', 'p1', 1, 9, 'delete'))
    out = run(job(leases=[lease()], services=[{'id': 'T', 'kind': 'tcp'}],
                 captures=capture(rows), queries=[10, 20]), 'withdrawal')
    first = lease_entry(out, 0)
    second = lease_entry(out, 1)
    check('withdrawal keeps the other witness',
          service_entry(second, 'T')['internal_open'] == [a(1)], second)
    check('withdrawal ledger', out['snapshots'][1]['ledger'] == {'live': 3, 'deleted': 1,
                                                                 'conflict': 0},
          out['snapshots'][1]['ledger'])
    # removing the last witness makes later application rows unbound
    rows = [row('icmp', 'only', 0, 5, 'put', 'L', 8, '0/i1', a(1), a(1), 'echo'),
            row('app', 'q', 0, 9, 'put', 'L', 6, '', a(1), '', 'open', 'T', 0),
            row('icmp', 'only', 1, 9, 'put', 'L', 8, '0/i1', a(1), a(1), 'echo')]
    out = run(job(leases=[lease()], services=[{'id': 'T', 'kind': 'tcp'}],
                 captures=capture(rows)), 'causality')
    check('app before witness is unbound',
          out['snapshots'][0]['unbound_applications'] == 1 and
          service_entry(lease_entry(out), 'T')['internal_open'] == [],
          out['snapshots'][0])


def case_capture_ordinal_and_budget():
    """Rejected ordinals are per capture and the record budget is cumulative."""
    good = row('icmp', 'g', 0, 5, 'put', 'L', 1, '0/i1', a(1), a(1), 'echo')
    bad = row('icmp', 'b', 0, 5, 'put', 'L', 1, '0/i9', a(1), a(1), 'echo')
    first = ','.join(HEADER) + '\r\n' + ','.join(str(x) for x in bad) + '\r\n' + \
        ','.join(str(x) for x in good) + '\r\n'
    second = HEADER + '\r\n' + ','.join(str(x) for x in good) + '\r\n' + \
        ','.join(str(x) for x in bad) + '\r\n'
    captures = [{'encoding': 'csv', 'chunks': [base64.b64encode(first.encode()).decode()]},
                {'encoding': 'csv', 'chunks': [base64.b64encode(second.encode()).decode()]}]
    out = run(job(leases=[lease()], captures=captures), 'ordinals')
    check('per-capture ordinals', out['rejected'] == [[0, 0], [1, 1]], out['rejected'])

    # a code point split across capture chunks is still one stream
    text = (HEADER + '\r\n' + ','.join(str(x) for x in good) + '\r\n' +
            ','.join(str(x) for x in ['icmp', 'é', 0, 5, 'put', 'L', 1, '0/i1', a(1),
                                      a(1), 'echo', '', '', '']) + '\r\n')
    blob = text.encode('utf-8')
    middle = blob.index('é'.encode()) + 1
    chunks = [base64.b64encode(blob[:middle]).decode(),
              base64.b64encode(blob[middle:]).decode()]
    out = run(job(leases=[lease()], captures=[{'encoding': 'csv', 'chunks': chunks}]),
              'split-codepoint')
    check('split code point parses', out['rejected'] == [[0, 1]] and
          out['snapshots'][0]['ledger']['live'] == 1, out['rejected'])

    # the 200000 logical data record budget is cumulative across captures
    import zstandard as zstd
    line = ','.join(str(x) for x in good)
    half = 100000
    blobs = []
    for _ in range(2):
        body = (HEADER + '\r\n' + ((line + '\r\n') * half)).encode()
        blobs.append(base64.b64encode(zstd.ZstdCompressor(level=3).compress(body)).decode())
    captures = [{'encoding': 'zstd', 'chunks': [blob]} for blob in blobs]
    try:
        campaign.audit(job(leases=[lease()], captures=captures))
        error = None
    except CaptureError:
        error = 'capture'
    check('capture error: record budget', error == 'capture', error)
    captures = [{'encoding': 'zstd', 'chunks': [blobs[0]]}]
    out = run(job(leases=[lease()], captures=captures), 'under budget')
    check('200000 records fit the budget', out['snapshots'][0]['ledger']['live'] == 100000,
          out['snapshots'][0]['ledger'])
